About Colette

The refined design of the Colette and Colette Office chairs is inspired by what Roberto Lazzeroni calls “the infinite catalogue of memory”. The classic profiles of the two chairs, upholstered in the finest leather, recall the elegance of yesteryear, a simple yet assured style that fully embodies the link between past and future, between convention and experimentation. Baxter's own meticulous research into materials is evident in the way it pairs leather - a living, evolving element with a story to tell - with fine woods to create completely original combinations. The possibility of customising every chair - choosing between the materials, the armrests, the comfort of the armchair version - makes Colette a unique and exclusive piece, an iconic chair that enhances any space: from the office to the dining room, from the bedroom to the living room.
